rule.statement: A defendant who fails to move the court to try a jurisdictional issue as a preliminary issue waives their objection to the court's jurisdiction.
rule.supporting_quote: His failure to move Court to try the said issue as a preliminary issue on such a vital matter will amount to a waiver of objections in regard to lack of jurisdiction of Court to hear and determine the defendant’s action.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 39 of the Judicature Act No 2 of 1978
